title: The Dialogues with My Love
subtitle: A Novel Based on a True Story
author: Leon & Nazurah
description: The intimate real conversations between Leon, an African boy from Uganda, and Nazurah, an Asian girl from Malaysia — from a casual Telegram greeting to a love that crossed oceans, time zones, and cultures.
style: Faithful, tender, epistolary prose built around real dialogue. Short chapters that follow the chronology of their messages.
notes: The story follows their true messages. Continue from the last conversation, preserving the real voices and the timeline. Each chapter documents the next phase of their relationship.
